method:
Hand review of ops/data/glp1-cardio/ctgov-exercise.json (from glp1_exercise_ctgov.py), 2026-10-19 ET.
Kept: randomized studies where people on semaglutide or tirzepatide get a structured exercise program in one arm
and the same drug without that program in another. Excluded: drug vs placebo on top of exercise (e.g. SLIMM 2),
exercise in every arm (HFpEF NCT07223242, NCT07485062 resistance vs balance-and-tone), lifestyle-coaching-only
programs, single-arm and observational studies.
